_provenance.encoding: ANDROID org.json: every "/" escaped as "\\/". The bundle this came from carries 648 such sequences. Verifying it with the reference JVM org.json rule fails every envelope digest; with the Android rule all of them verify.
_provenance.producer: Market Radar 2.6.97 / b528 on the phone (brain_version 2.6.97 in that bundle)
_provenance.what_is_kept: ONLY the premium objects whose digests this fixture checks - every slot envelope, both cohorts, the records of the first two acquisitions per index, and each index's evidence_context, which is the provenance the verifier reads to choose the encoding profile. Kept BYTE-FOR-BYTE.
_provenance.what_is_removed: every other part of the phone bundle - Paper positions, trades, the brain parts and the authority/learning ledgers. None is covered by these digests, and raw phone exports do not belong in the repository.
